title: Helpers on your behalf
sub: The fourth film of From helper to colleague, the third series on AI agents in data work: a helper on a person's sign-in works with that person's rights, so the protections that hold are the platform's, in Databricks and in dbt, whoever types.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's look: a pale marble wall over an oak floor, light from a window on the right. A helper is a ceramic sphere with a violet band, never a person, with its person's name under it. Blue is structure (a tool, a setting, a grant, the platform's limits), violet the model, orange the data and its evidence, green what a person approved or what held, amber what went wrong or nearly did.
